achievements.name: Lilac and Gooseberries
achievements.desc: Find Yennefer of Vengerberg.

achievements.name: A Friend in Need
achievements.desc: Find and free Dandelion.

achievements.name: Necromancer
achievements.desc: Help Yennefer extract information from Skjall's body.

achievements.name: Family Counselor
achievements.desc: Find the baron's wife and daughter.

achievements.name: Something More
achievements.desc: Find Ciri.

achievements.name: Xenonaut
achievements.desc: Visit Tir ná Lia and convince Ge'els to betray Eredin.

achievements.name: The King is Dead
achievements.desc: Defeat Eredin.

achievements.name: Passed the Trial
achievements.desc: Finish the game on any difficulty.

achievements.name: Ran the Gauntlet
achievements.desc: Finish the game on the "Blood and Broken Bones!" or "Death March!" difficulty levels.

achievements.name: Walked the Path
achievements.desc: Finish the game on the "Death March!" difficulty level.

achievements.name: Geralt: The Professional
achievements.desc: Complete all witcher contracts.

achievements.name: Kingmaker
achievements.desc: Complete the subplot about choosing Skellige's ruler.

achievements.name: Assassin of Kings
achievements.desc: Take part in the assassination of King Radovid.

achievements.name: Friends With Benefits
achievements.desc: Complete the subplot involving Keira Metz.

achievements.name: Full Crew
achievements.desc: Bring all possible allies to Kaer Morhen for the battle against the Hunt.

achievements.name: Dendrologist
achievements.desc: Acquire all the Abilities in one tree.

achievements.name: The Enemy of My Enemy
achievements.desc: Use the Axii Sign to force one opponent to kill another. Do this 20 times.

achievements.name: Humpty Dumpty
achievements.desc: Kill 10 opponents by knocking them off somewhere high with the Aard Sign.

achievements.name: Environmentally Unfriendly
achievements.desc: Kill 50 opponents using the environment (e.g. swamp gas, insects or objects).

achievements.name: Kaer Morhen Trained
achievements.desc: Perform 10 effective counterattacks in a row without getting hit or parrying.

achievements.name: Can't Touch This!
achievements.desc: Kill 5 foes in a fight without taking damage (except for Toxicity) and without using the Quen Sign.

achievements.name: That Is the Evilest Thing
achievements.desc: Ignite the gas produced by a Dragon's Dream bomb using a burning opponent. Do this 10 times.

achievements.name: Mutant
achievements.desc: Fill all mutagen slots.

achievements.name: Butcher of Blaviken
achievements.desc: Kill at least 5 opponents in under 10 seconds.

achievements.name: Triple Threat
achievements.desc: Kill 3 opponents in one fight using 3 different methods (swords, bombs, crossbow, Signs, etc.).

achievements.name: Brawler
achievements.desc: Defeat Olaf, the Skellige champion of unarmed combat.

achievements.name: Overkill
achievements.desc: Make an opponent suffer from bleeding, poisoning and burning simultaneously. Do this 10 times.

achievements.name: Master Marksman
achievements.desc: Kill 50 human and nonhuman opponents by striking them in the head with a crossbow bolt.

achievements.name: What Was That?
achievements.desc: Attack, counter, cast a Sign and throw a bomb (in any order) in under 4 seconds.

achievements.name: Even Odds
achievements.desc: Kill 2 monsters you have a contract on without using Signs, potions, mutagens, oils or bombs.

achievements.name: Globetrotter
achievements.desc: Discover 100 fast travel points.

achievements.name: Pest Control
achievements.desc: Destroy all monster nests in the Velen / Novigrad region, or in Skellige.

achievements.name: Card Collector
achievements.desc: Acquire all gwent cards available in the base version of the game.

achievements.name: Gwent Master
achievements.desc: Defeat Tybalt and win the gwent tournament held at the Passiflora.

achievements.name: Let's Cook!
achievements.desc: Learn 12 potion formulae.

achievements.name: Bombardier
achievements.desc: Collect the formulae for 6 different bomb types.

achievements.name: Bookworm
achievements.desc: Read 30 books, journals or other documents.

achievements.name: Armed and Dangerous
achievements.desc: Find and equip all the elements of one set of witcher gear.

achievements.name: Power Overwhelming
achievements.desc: Have all possible Place of Power bonuses active at the same time.

achievements.name: Brawl Master
achievements.desc: Complete all fistfighting quests in Velen, Skellige and Novigrad.

achievements.name: Fast and Furious
achievements.desc: Win all the horse races in the game.

achievements.name: Munchkin
achievements.desc: Reach character development level 35.

achievements.name: Fire in the Hole
achievements.desc: Destroy 10 monster nests using bombs.

achievements.name: Fist of the South Star
achievements.desc: Defeat an opponent in a fistfight without taking any damage.

achievements.name: Geralt and Friends
achievements.desc: Win a round of gwent using only neutral cards.

achievements.name: All In
achievements.desc: Play three hero cards in one round of gwent and win the match.

achievements.name: Shrieker
achievements.desc: Complete the contract on the shrieker.

achievements.name: Fearless Vampire Slayer
achievements.desc: Complete the contract on Sarasti.

achievements.name: Woodland Spirit
achievements.desc: Complete the contract on the Woodland Spirit.

achievements.name: Fiend or Foe?
achievements.desc: Complete the contract on Morvudd.

achievements.name: Ashes to Ashes
achievements.desc: Complete the contract on Therazane.

achievements.name: The Doppler Effect
achievements.desc: Resolve the doppler problem in Novigrad.

achievements.name: I'm Not Kissing That
achievements.desc: Kill the prince cursed into a toad.

achievements.name: Let the Good Times Roll!
achievements.desc: Participate in all the activities at the wedding.

achievements.name: Shopaholic
achievements.desc: Buy all the items put on the block at the Borsodis' Auction House.

achievements.name: Curator of Nightmares
achievements.desc: Recreate all of Iris' nightmares in the Painted World.

achievements.name: Pacta Sunt Servanda
achievements.desc: Finish the "Hearts of Stone" expansion.

achievements.name: When It's Many Against One…
achievements.desc: Provoke all Iris von Everec's Nightmares into fighting you at the same time and defeat them.

achievements.name: Return to Sender
achievements.desc: Kill 3 opponents with their own arrows.

achievements.name: Can Quit Anytime I Want
achievements.desc: Be under the influence of seven potions or decoctions at the same time.

achievements.name: Wild Rose Dethorned
achievements.desc: Defeat all the fallen knights and loot their campsites.

achievements.name: I Wore Ofieri Before It Was Cool
achievements.desc: Collect all available Ofieri armor and horse gear, and at least one Ofieri sword.

achievements.name: Moo-rderer
achievements.desc: Kill 20 cows.

achievements.name: Rad Steez, Bro!
achievements.desc: Slide downhill uninterrupted for at least 10 seconds.

achievements.name: Killed It
achievements.desc: Win a round of gwent with a total strength of at least 187.

achievements.name: The Witcher's Gone South
achievements.desc: Travel to the Duchy of Toussaint.

achievements.name: Last Action Hero
achievements.desc: Be decorated with the Order of Vitis Vinifera.

achievements.name: Kling of the Clink
achievements.desc: Serve time in Toussaint.

achievements.name: A Knight to Remember
achievements.desc: Obtain a flawless victory in all the competitions during the knights' tourney.

achievements.name: Embodiment of the Five Virtues
achievements.desc: Be given Aerondight by the Lady of the Lake.

achievements.name: Playing House
achievements.desc: Use all available options for developing Corvo Bianco.

achievements.name: Turned Every Stone
achievements.desc: Find all grandmaster diagrams for each witcher school.

achievements.name: I Have a Gwent Problem
achievements.desc: Collect all the cards in the Skellige deck.

achievements.name: The Grapes of Wrath Stomped
achievements.desc: Help unite the warring vineyards and have a wine named in your honor.

achievements.name: Dressed to Kill
achievements.desc: Unlock the bonus for equipping all the witcher gear elements from one School.

achievements.name: Weapon "W"
achievements.desc: Develop a mutation.

achievements.name: Hasta la Vista™
achievements.desc: Kill a frozen opponent with a crossbow bolt.

achievements.name: David and Golyat
achievements.desc: Kill Golyat with a crossbow bolt to his eye.
